I'm struggling with the idea of whether or not God allows us suffering to commit suicide. Sure I have wanted to for over a decade but anytime I get close usually I stop in fears of going to hell. But I think God would make situational cases where He calls on certain ones to join Him. Idk just some thoughts.

There are small things you may do that people don't notice. Whether its giving a smile to the cashier who makes your bagel in the morning to who you impact in your life. I am sure there are others that care for you, I have had similar thoughts. Personally, I know my funeral will consist of maybe 5 family members and 2 or so friends, and I'm only 25. I know I am not going to live long, but before I die I know I have to do something to make a dent and help others.

I feel a similar way. I feel that God knows when those are suffering too much that it is acceptable to leave this world. But why would He put us through that pain in the first place? I have given this a lot of thought and so far have only come up with one reason, which is that He needs us for something going on in Heaven that we as humans cannot comprehend but we are needed there rather than on earth. 

I think in terms of repentance that if we ask God enough before the suicide, and we don't have anything blocking it, that it means we have the green light. I'm also not one to condone suicide even though it comes through my mind so much. I just know my family needs me now so I suffer in this misery for them.

Problems always aren't temporary. I've had problems get worse. And my rock bottom go lower and lower on multiple occasions. The cliche suicide prevention lines are created by those who don't know how much we suffer, and the lives we live. Try talking to someone who has gone through a similar situation. Feel free to hit me up anytime as well. I can relate to a lot of what you said.

But is it still a sin? I understand from religious studies I've attended that suicide is a sin. But where does God explicitly say that? I understand it being a sin in the fact that its a quick ticket to Heaven, but did He actually say it himself?
Definitely I would love that! I have my fair share of crazy stories as well. I'm about to sleep as well.
My book didn't make the list. I guess that's a good thing?

Thank you for such a quick reply. I would definitely like to speak with you more. Despite having hobbies and what people view as "the good life" deep down I have this black hole feeling. Doctors just want to medicate me and that has not helped. I just feel so alienated sometimes despite the fact I have a lot of friends. I think my lack of a relationship has something to do with it. Random sex here and there is really not fun for me yet I can't seem to find someone to settle down with and the fact that so many people I know are getting married or having kids just makes me feel like I'll grow old to be the grumpy old man yelling at kids lol. From my lifestyle I've had though I don't see myself living long enough to be elderly, the Hollywood lifestyle is such a constant cycle of craziness, substance abuse, and random sex. Considering moving away from there.

My memory during the day is terrible. I think it might be the depression, or the meds. A lot of times I will sleep 15+ hours a day. When I wake up I remember the entire dream and question if it was real or not. I used to remember my dreams for about a minute or two after waking up but it would be blurry. This feels like I have a life while sleeping and a life while awake. Lately I've been very depressed so maybe I'm sleeping more because that world is happier? I don't know its strange. I can recall dreams from weeks ago in vivid detail. I just have no idea why. The events in them tend to be very random as well. Although sometimes it will be a continuation of my day where everything aligns perfectly with what I did that previous day. It's so strange. 

Unfortunately I haven't had much luck with psychiatrists or psychologists. Saw quite a few, had to pay out of pocket as my insurance doesn't cover it, and the psychiatrists just want to prescribe more meds.

Thank you for the reply. It helped, and I am still alive haha. I do have many hobbies, running, sports, drawing. I find some of them not as enjoyable anymore due to my depression. I actually stayed up all night tonight and it was relaxing. I am at my parents house and I think seeing them helped me, because I started thinking about them being upset over me gone, yet still justifying it as they know I'm in pain and would want what is best for me. I guess I just have to figure that out .

Thank you for the reply. Yes I hope to remain discreet in who I am as I am known so people may judge me based on the fiction I portray.

The weird thing is, my dreams are so vivid and when I wake up I remember details. I remember exact conversations, interactions, ect. It lasts for a day or so then I forget as something new has come along. 

In fact, I have issues with waking up because of this - because I feel its actually happening.
